### `Workflow.spec.kv[].tables[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The table's name, unique within the store. |
| `owner` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The one Function that may write the table, in the store's namespace. In a store that a Function declares, it defaults to that Function.
